queries: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_order_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) AS average_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(gc.invoiced_order_count) AS average_invoiced_order_count, AVG(gc.invoiced_order_count - overall.average_count) AS average_amount_above_overall FROM gender_counts AS gc CROSS JOIN overall WHERE gc.invoiced_order_count > overall.average_count;

WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_order_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) AS avg_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.invoiced_order_count) AS avg_invoiced_order_count, AVG(g.invoiced_order_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_excess_overall_average FROM gender_counts AS g CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a WHERE g.invoiced_order_count > a.avg_count;

WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_order_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(invoiced_order_count AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(CAST(g.invoiced_order_count AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_invoiced_order_count, AVG(g.invoiced_order_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM gender_counts AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE g.invoiced_order_count > a.avg_count;

WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.invoice_number IS NOT NULL THEN o.order_id END) AS invoiced_order_count FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(invoiced_order_count AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(CAST(g.invoiced_order_count AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_invoiced_order_count, AVG(g.invoiced_order_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM gender_counts AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE g.invoiced_order_count > a.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: The per-gender average includes only genders represented by at least one invoice.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every gender present in Customers, assigning zero invoiced orders to genders with none.
